mentions.name: Abbox
mentions.description: This tool helps engineers stay focused on tasks for longer by shielding them from interruptions by non-technical people making small requests, such as minor website tweaks, tracking additions, video playback fixes, and style corrections against Figma.
mentions.problem: Engineers get constantly interrupted by non-technical colleagues with small requests (e.g., change an h1 to h2, add tracking to a share button, fix video playback, match styles to Figma), breaking their focus, and it is hard to piece together needs since every department has its own opinions about the website.
mentions.audience: Engineers who get distracted by small requests from non-technical people across departments.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Abbox trying to help engineers focus longer on tasks without being interrupted by non-technical people with small requests.

evidence.value: I am building Abbox trying to help engineers focus longer on tasks without being interrupted by non-technical people with small requests.
evidence.author: elchuzade
